name: FA_LEASE_INVOICES
description: This table contains the header details of each lease invoice.

columns.name: LEASE_INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease invoice identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined lease number of the lease.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Unique invoice identifier.

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.description: Unique number for the supplier invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Invoice date used to calculate the due date according to the payment terms.

columns.name: LESSOR_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the lessor. Lessors must be set as valid suppliers.

columns.name: LESSOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the location to which the payment will be sent.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book in which the lease is recorded.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the lease invoice line.

columns.name: TRANSFER_DATE
columns.description: Date when the invoice line is transferred to Oracle Fusion Payables.

columns.name: INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount for which the invoice is prepared.

columns.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the invoice.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Encoded message text associated with a failure of the posting program.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
